digest.component_or_area: tickets-store git maintenance and bridge-history reclaim
propositions: The filtered tickets-store pack exceeds CI gate limit (131431 KiB > 131072 KiB) on stale-based changes; proactive maintenance repack/gc adds headroom to reduce recurring stale-base failures.

Before any store mutation, operator must explicitly confirm zero active sessions and all rebar-mcp servers stopped; quiet-window gates (workflows disabled, no in-flight runs, lock/gate refs absent, timers paused) must be revalidated.

Pre-repair and final off-repo git bundles must be created, verified, and retained as atomic rollback artifacts before and after coordinated ticket-30d3 repair; identity equivalence (event_uuid, verdict, grandfathered multisets) must match pre/post rewrite when commit SHAs are ignored.

History rewrite via git fast-export/filter/fast-import strips spent .bridge_state history; repack/gc follows only after both verified bundles exist; force-with-lease publication requires old-tip not present as ancestor in any default-cloned ref.

Deterministic first post-rewrite write (review-bot LLM-Review +1 vote) must execute with REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_DRAIN=off, produce exactly four canonical review-artifact commits (CREATE, REVIEW_RESULT, two links) with no interleave, and remain under 1 MiB growth with old-tip ancestry false.

Post-enable reconciliation (either GitHub Actions run or operator-approved signed CLI sequence with zero mutation/recovery failures) plus final fsck (zero repairs, four intentional STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED records on 4214/72d5/b043/fc9e) must complete and pass before operator may allow sessions to resume.
